The '''Spring Onion''' is a [[Foraging|foraged]] item found in [[Spring]] in [[Cindersap Forest]], but only on the southeast island (''i.e.,'' north of [[the Sewers]] entrance).  Unlike other foraged items, spring onions are respawned daily: all unharvested onions are removed at the end of each day, and new onions may appear. The [[Livin' Off The Land]] [[Television]] channel airs a tip about Spring Onions on day 4. Spring Onions may randomly appear in the [[Traveling Cart]]'s stock for {{Tprice|8}}.

Harvesting a Spring Onion grants the player 3 Foraging XP. Only one onion can be harvested per plant; the [[Skills#Foraging|Gatherer]] profession does not apply to spring onions.

Once the player has earned 8 hearts of [[friendship]] with [[Jas]] and [[Vincent]], [[Spring Onion Mastery]] can be obtained, which permanently increases the sell price of Spring Onions by 5×.

===Gifting Spring Onion Juice===
Spring Onion [[Juice]] is the cheapest juice available for gifting.{{#lsth:Juice|Gifting}}
===Gifting Pickled Spring Onion===
Spring Onion [[Jellies and Pickles|Pickles]] is the cheapest pickles available for gifting.{{#lsth:Jellies and Pickles|Gifting Pickles}}
==Bundles==
Spring Onion is an option in the {{Bundle|spring forage remixed||y}}.

==Recipes==
Spring Onion is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Spring Onion is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt258.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Spring Shirt]].

==Quests==
Spring Onion is not used in any [[quests]].

{{History|1.5|Is now an option in the remixed Spring Foraging Bundle.}}
